en: John 7

p.src: 1  After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

en: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
u.src: 1  After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

p.src: 2  Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

en: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.
u.src: 2  Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

p.src: 3  His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

en: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.
u.src: 3  His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

p.src: 4  For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

en: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”
u.src: 4  For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

p.src: 5  For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.

en: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.
u.src: 5  For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.

p.src: 6  Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

en: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
u.src: 6  Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

p.src: 7  The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

en: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
u.src: 7  The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

p.src: 8  You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

en: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”
u.src: 8  You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

p.src: 9  Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

en: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.
u.src: 9  Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

p.src: 10  But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

en: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
u.src: 10  But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

p.src: 11  The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

en: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”
u.src: 11  The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

p.src: 12  There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”

zh: 眾人為他紛紛議論，有的說：「他是好人。」有的說：「不然，他是迷惑眾人的。」
en: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”
u.src: 12  There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”

p.src: 13  Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

en: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.
u.src: 13  Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

p.src: 14  But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

en: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.
u.src: 14  But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

p.src: 15  The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

en: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”
u.src: 15  The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

p.src: 16  Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

en: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
u.src: 16  Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

p.src: 17  If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.

en: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.
u.src: 17  If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.

p.src: 18  He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

en: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
u.src: 18  He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

p.src: 19  Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

en: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
u.src: 19  Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

p.src: 20  The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”

en: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”
u.src: 20  The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”

p.src: 21  Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

en: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.
u.src: 21  Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

p.src: 22  Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

en: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.
u.src: 22  Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

p.src: 23  If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

en: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?
u.src: 23  If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

p.src: 24  Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

en: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
u.src: 24  Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

p.src: 25  Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?

en: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?
u.src: 25  Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?

p.src: 26  Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

en: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?
u.src: 26  Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

p.src: 27  However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”

en: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”
u.src: 27  However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”

p.src: 28  Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

en: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.
u.src: 28  Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

p.src: 29  I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

en: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”
u.src: 29  I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

p.src: 30  They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

en: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
u.src: 30  They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

p.src: 31  But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”

en: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”
u.src: 31  But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”

p.src: 32  The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

en: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.
u.src: 32  The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

p.src: 33  Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

en: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.
u.src: 33  Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

p.src: 34  You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”

en: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”
u.src: 34  You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”

p.src: 35  The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

en: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
u.src: 35  The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

en: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”

en: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

p.src: 39  But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.
